d:
Jharkhand INDIA Alliance : jharkhand men INDIA gathbandhan ki siyasat men ab 'tala-chabi' ki entri ho gaee hai. RJD vidhayak dal ke neta suresh pasvan ne dava kiya hai ki aane vala vakt RJD ka hoga aur gathbandhan sarkar ki chabi uske pas rahegi.
RJD ne panchayat se lekar pradesh star tak sangthan majbut karne ki bat kahi hai. vahin, kangres ne is bayan par pratikriya dete hue kaha ki gathbandhan men chabi kisi ek ke pas nahin, balki sabhi ke pas hai. dusri or BJP ne ise gathbandhan men samanvay ki kami se jorkar saval uthae hain.
